content.introduction: On 2 October 2026, Bank of Japan Gov. Kazuo Ueda highlighted interest rates, bank lending, and asset markets as key factors for further rate hikes. New World Development exited the 11 Skies mall project with Airport Authority Hong Kong, causing its shares to swing from gain to loss. Struggling Japanese motor maker Nidec is expected to record a massive impairment loss of over $3.8bn due to its loss-making EV motor systems business. The Nikkei Stock Average has seen increased volatility since reaching a record high on June 25. The sources don't provide a definitive answer on the current market status beyond these events.
